title: Neurobiological substrates of cue-elicited craving and anhedonia in recently abstinent opioid-dependent males
read_from: article text only; no pondie record consulted for any value

conventions.support: stated = the paper says it; inferred = an expert reading would agree but the paper does not say it; absent = the paper does not report it and `value` is null
conventions.also_acceptable: other values a careful reader could defend; a write matching one of these scores correct, not wrong
conventions.entity keys: chosen by the reviewer from the article, not from any record; `identified_by` says how to match a record entity to it
conventions.match: substrings that identify this entity in a record, taken from the article's own words; matched against the entity's local_id and label so scoring does not inherit the record's idea of what an entity is

is_healthy.quote: Sixteen abstinent male opioid-dependent patients (mean age = 42.8 years, S.D. = 5.2, range = 30–52) and 18 healthy control subjects (mean age = 40.4 years, S.D. = 10, range = 23–54) were included.

enrolled_count.quote: Sixteen abstinent male opioid-dependent patients (mean age = 42.8 years, S.D. = 5.2, range = 30–52) and 18 healthy control subjects (mean age = 40.4 years, S.D. = 10, range = 23–54) were included.

acquired_count.quote: As a consequence, the final sample consisted of 12 opioid-dependent patients (mean age = 44.5 years, S.D. = 3.9, range = 39–53) and 17 healthy controls (mean age = 40.0 years, S.D. = 10.1, range = 23–54) (n.s.).
acquired_count.note: The paper reports 16 included and 12 analysed and never states how many were scanned. Three were dropped for missing fMRI data (acquisition failed) and one for haloperidol use (scanned, then excluded), so `acquired` is strictly 13 by the slot's own definition. 12 is what a reader will write; 13 and 16 are defensible.

excluded_count.quote: One patient was excluded from data analysis because of haloperidol use the day before the fMRI scanning procedure took place. In addition, one control subject and three patients were excluded, because no complete fMRI data were available due to technical failures.
excluded_count.note: 1 + 3; the paper never prints the sum.

age_mean.quote: As a consequence, the final sample consisted of 12 opioid-dependent patients (mean age = 44.5 years, S.D. = 3.9, range = 39–53) and 17 healthy controls (mean age = 40.0 years, S.D. = 10.1, range = 23–54) (n.s.).
age_mean.note: The paper reports two means: 42.8 for the 16 included, 44.5 for the 12 analysed. 44.5 is the one that goes with acquired_count 12.

age_standard_deviation.quote: the final sample consisted of 12 opioid-dependent patients (mean age = 44.5 years, S.D. = 3.9, range = 39–53)

medications.quote: Inclusion criteria were (a) male, (b) age 18–55 years, (c) absence of major internal, neurological and psychiatric disorders (d) diagnosed with DSM-IV heroin dependence, (e) heroin as primary drug of abuse, (f) inhalation as primary route of administration, (g) smoking cigarettes, and (h) no current psychotropic medication.
medications.note: THE FAILURE CASE. The analysed cohort took no psychotropic medication by inclusion criterion (h). `haloperidol` appears once in the paper -- "One patient was excluded from data analysis because of haloperidol use the day before the fMRI scanning procedure took place" -- and names a person removed from this group. The slot says "The drugs or other agents this cohort was taking", so both null and an explicit empty list are right and `haloperidol` is wrong. "no current psychotropic medication" is also wrong here: the slot says "Names only", and that string is a criterion, not an agent.

diagnostic_instrument.quote: All opioid-dependent subjects were recruited from inpatient facilities in the Netherlands where they were pre-screened by the treatment staff and interviewed for the verification of inclusion and exclusion criteria.
diagnostic_instrument.note: No named diagnostic instrument. ASI, OCDUS, DDQ and SHAPS are administered in this study but the paper assigns them to drug-use history, craving and anhedonia, never to establishing the diagnosis: "The alcohol and drug section of the Addiction Severity Index (ASI) was used to evaluate each participant's drug use and drug use history".

correction_regions.note: SECOND FAILURE CASE. The mask is the main-effect map, not a named region. The subthalamic nucleus is a *result* of this contrast -- "a significant group × stimulus interaction effect for the subthalamic nucleus (STN)" -- so writing the STN as a correction region turns a finding into a method.

correction_regions.quote: Brain regions that show co-activation with the subthalamic nucleus (STN) in opiate-dependent subjects
correction_regions.note: The Methods never describe this analysis. The Data analysis section lists exactly three procedures -- FDR-corrected main effects, inclusively masked interactions, and uncorrected regressions -- and none of them is a co-activation analysis. So every parameter of this InferenceSettings is absent, and `correction_regions` in particular: the STN is what the analysis is ABOUT, and "region of interest", "small volume" and word-boundary ROI occur zero times in this paper.
